name: LEAGUES OF VOTANN: CTHONIAN PROSPECT
description: Strike the earth and claim the resources that are rightfully yours with the Cthonian Prospect, a perfect pairing of Brôkhyr artifice and Cthonian resilience. A Brôkhyr Iron-master leads a team of three Brôkhyr Thunderkyn with his Ironkin Assistant and three E-COG drones, backed up by 10 Cthonian Beserks, a Kapricus Defender (that can alternatively be built as a Kapricus Carrier), and two Cthonian Earthshakers.This box also includes two Leagues of Votann transfer sheets with 555 transfers each.
